title: Speaking at DEF CON: Interview with Andra Lezza
teaser: Helvetigoth interviews first-time speaker Andra Lezza on CFP preparation, stage delivery, and presenting technical research at DEF CON.

title: Open Source in Government: Interview with Jordan Kasper
teaser: Jordan Kasper analyzes the adoption of open-source software in government agencies and public-sector obligations to upstream maintainers.

title: Long-Form Interview: Torvik from Tulip Tree Tech
teaser: Silk conducts a long-form interview with Torvik of Tulip Tree Tech, discussing custom silicon, PCB manufacturing, and indie hardware projects.

title: DARPA AIxCC with Shellphish
teaser: Silk interviews members of legendary hacking group Shellphish on competing in DARPA's AI Cyber Challenge and automated vulnerability reasoning.

title: The DEF CON Run Tradition with Shepard and Panda
teaser: Shepard and Panda join Silk to share the origins, history, and community camaraderie behind the unofficial DEF CON morning run.

title: NextGen Hacking: Youth Education and Mentorship
teaser: Silk explores DEF CON NextGen, a community initiative providing cybersecurity education, hardware soldering, and safe hacking spaces for youth.

title: Hak5 Pager: Paging and Wi-Fi Pineapple Features
teaser: Darren Kitchen presents the Hak5 Pager, exploring retro form factors embedded with modern wireless penetration-testing capabilities.

title: KevOps Sahara Pool Party and Community Gathering
teaser: A look at the KevOps community pool party at the Sahara, celebrating hacker camaraderie, music, and after-hours social traditions.

title: Creating the Electronic Badge: Interview with Mar Williams
teaser: Artist and hardware designer Mar Williams discusses creating the official DEF CON 33 electronic badge and convention visual artwork.

title: Retro Tech Community and Badgelife Live Showcase
teaser: A live panel with d3dbot, psyop, and grrrizzzz exploring the intersection of retro hardware preservation, custom silicon, and badge culture.

title: ICS Village Water Treatment Plant Simulation
teaser: ICS Village engineers explain their fully operational miniature water treatment plant display and process-level exploitation vectors.

title: Ten Years of the IoT Village: Anniversary Preview
teaser: A celebration of ten years of the Internet of Things Village, reviewing a decade of embedded router research, zero-days, and bug bounties.

title: RedAlert ICS CTF Walkthrough
teaser: An introduction to the RedAlert ICS CTF, pitting competitors against simulated critical infrastructure networks and industrial controllers.

title: Bug Bounty Village Remote and In-Person Challenges
teaser: Organizers highlight remote and in-person participation options, live target scopes, and bounty opportunities at Bug Bounty Village.

title: GenSec CTF at DEF CON 33
teaser: A quick look at the GenSec CTF competition at DEF CON 33, challenging participants across diverse cybersecurity skill sets.

title: Red Team Village at DEF CON 33 Spotlight
teaser: An update on attack workshops, offensive tool releases, and adversary emulation labs happening in the Red Team Village at DEF CON 33.

title: Contest Operations Update with Tiberius
teaser: Contest runner Tiberius provides an operational update on official DEF CON 33 contests, scoring protocols, and participant challenges.

title: Mobile Hacking Community Spotlight
teaser: d3dbot catches up with the Mobile Hacking Community at DEF CON 33, exploring baseband analysis, Android internals, and iOS jailbreaking research.

title: Fortress Island: Physical Security in Voting Systems
teaser: Reviews publicly documented physical security controls and tamper-evident seals on deployed voting systems, exposing critical weaknesses in hardware defenses.

title: It's Not Safe Yet: Online Voting in Practice
teaser: Examines the systemic security, cryptographic, and client-side malware risks of internet voting in commercial and public election deployments.

title: Is E2E Verifiability a Magic Bullet for Online Voting
teaser: Explains why End-to-End Verifiability (E2E-V) fails to protect online voting systems against client-side endpoint malware and server infrastructure tampering.

title: CARVER Vuln Analysis & US Voting System
teaser: Applies the military CARVER targeting and vulnerability analysis matrix to evaluate systemic risks and physical attack vectors across the US election system.

title: Risk Limiting Audits: What They Are and Aren't
teaser: Election auditing pioneer Philip Stark details how Risk-Limiting Audits (RLAs) provide statistical verification of paper ballots while warning against auditing untrustworthy vote records.

title: Dominion ICX Simple Hacks Daunting Recoveries
teaser: Demonstrates real-time ballot manipulation on the Dominion ImageCast X touchscreen terminal and explains why recovering from election definition tampering is daunting.

title: Regulatory Failures with Ballot Marking Devices
teaser: Examines regulatory and certification failures surrounding Ballot Marking Devices, focusing on barcode vote encoding and ballot image discrepancies.

title: When the Paper Trail Leads Nowhere
teaser: Chronicles the technical failures, security vulnerabilities, and recount challenges of Los Angeles County's $300M bespoke VSAP voting system.

title: Protecting Election Researchers Globally
teaser: Advocates for expanding legal safe harbor protections for election security researchers globally, drawing on lessons from research barriers in Nigeria.

title: A Review of Post Election Audits in Swing States
teaser: Evaluates the effectiveness, rigor, and reliability of post-election audits conducted across seven closely contested swing states following the 2024 election.

title: Evidence Based Elections and Software Independence
teaser: Turing Award winner Ron Rivest explains software independence and evidence-based elections as foundational principles for securing democratic processes.

title: DMCA Security Research Exemption and Election Security
teaser: Breaks down the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA) Section 1201 security research exemptions that protect independent voting system audits at the Voting Village.

title: A NY Legal Challenge to ExpressVote XL's Barcode Use
teaser: Susan Lerner reviews the legal challenge in Common Cause NY v. Kosinski against the ES&S ExpressVote XL over barcode vote encoding and voter verifiability laws.

title: When Insiders Are the Threat
teaser: Examines multi-state insider access schemes where voting machine software and system images were illicitly copied across Colorado, Georgia, Michigan, and Pennsylvania.

title: Reflections on TTBR & Everest
teaser: Core researchers and public officials reflect on California's landmark Top-to-Bottom Review (TTBR) and Ohio's EVEREST study, evaluating their legacy for election security.

title: History and Significance of the TTBR and PEASWG
teaser: Former California Secretary of State Debra Bowen presents the history and enduring significance of the Top-to-Bottom Review (TTBR) and post-election audit working groups.

title: Welcome and Introductions
teaser: Organizers welcome attendees to the DEF CON 33 Voting Village, introducing the symposium schedule, hands-on hacking labs, and voting machine targets.
